brief: A salad staircase against a sunny kitchen wall: three rows of three planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back, so the back row does not shade the front. Lettuce seedlings in the front row, young lettuce in the middle row and full-size romaine at the back. Fill every planter with soil and plant it.

finish.summary: Built 3x3 stepped planter staircase: front row 1 storey, middle 2 storeys, back 3 storeys, each topped with a full-depth bin. All 9 bins filled with soil and planted: romaine seedlings front, romaine young middle, romaine harvest back. check_build clear, visible from front and above.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
